QuestInfo.name: Black Wings' New Weapon
QuestInfo.0: #p2151000# seems to be feeling better now. You should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
The Black Wings's new weapon has already been completed. #p2151000# realized how dangerous it was and tried to destroy it, but ended up getting thrown in jail. You can't just sit there and do nothing! Destroy the #rBlack Wings's new weapon#k and rescue #p2151000#!

#o9001035##r #a230501##k

#b(* If you leave the map, you can enter again through the hidden Laboratory entrance in #r#m310060220##b.)
QuestInfo.2: After completely destroying the Black Wings' new weapon, you returned with #p2151000# using the Underground Base #t4032740#. It was no easy task, but you handled it like a pro

0.0: Oof. I think I can move now. (Clears his throat) Right. As you may know, my mission was to prevent the development of the Black Wings' new weapon, but when I got here, the weapon was already complete. I don't know how they plan to use it, but the #r#o9001035##k seemed incredibly dangerous...
0.1: It hadn't been fully tested, but I wanted to stop it from being delivered, so I tried to destroy it...alone. And, well, I failed. The poison gas was potent. And that's how I ended up here...
0.2: Hey, is that a #t4032740#? As much as I'd like to use it, we can't just leave this place in good conscience. The poison gas in that device could wipe out all of Edelstein in an instant! We HAVE to destroy that weapon before we leave.

yes.0: I don't honestly know if you'll be able to pull it off. I'm not sure if a normal person could survive exposure to the poison gas. I hate to admit it, but you're my best student. If anyone can do this, it's you.
yes.1: The new weapon is on the other side of #bthat door#k. You'd better destroy it before they decide to test it on us!

no.0: The poison gas can target a large population all at once! The Black Wings can point that thing toward Edelstein at a whim. You've gotta help me destroy it!

mob.0: Have you not destroyed the #r#o9001035##k yet? Its poison is EXTREMELY potent so you'd better prepare yourself. Grrr, if only I'd brought more potions and antidotes!
